faq_heading: Homes near Colebrook Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Colebrook Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Colebrook Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Colebrook Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Colebrook Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 15 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,775,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Colebrook Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Colebrook Elementary the median was 55 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 13% of sales above the list price for the 15 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Colebrook Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Al-Mustafa School (0.1 km south-west), J T Brown Elementary (1.1 km north) and Panorama Park Elementary (1.6 km north).

Colebrook Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 5404 125a St. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Colebrook Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Colebrook Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Colebrook Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Colebrook Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 15 homes sold within 1 km of Colebrook Elementary: 11 houses and 4 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,775,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Colebrook Elementary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Colebrook Elementary in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Al-Mustafa School, 0.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Henry Bose Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (2.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (2.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Al-Mustafa School (0.1 km south-west), J T Brown Elementary (1.1 km north), Panorama Park Elementary (1.6 km north), Boundary Park Elementary (1.8 km north), Pinewood Elementary (2.2 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is J T Brown Elementary, 1.1 km north of Colebrook Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Colebrook Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Colebrook Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Colebrook Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Colebrook Elementary was $1,775,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Al-Mustafa School, the nearest other elementary school, 0.1 km south-west of Colebrook Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
